model_grain: one row per MSA; 50 independent economic settings, not 5000 independent rows

baseline.method: Employment-proportional count baseline; estimate count/private-job rate using each training fold only
baseline.exposure: msa_private_employment_2024 in metro_economic_inputs_2024; exp(log_msa_private_employment) in training file

regularized_regression.primary: Penalized Poisson regression using the broad predictor allowlist
regularized_regression.alternative: Ridge on log1p(count), with explicitly checked retransformation and nonnegative predictions
regularized_regression.processing: Training-fold median imputation and missing flags, training-fold standardization; alpha chosen inside development CV

conservative_xgboost.starting_search: max_depth 1 or 2; strong L1/L2 penalties; learning_rate 0.02-0.05; capped tree counts tuned only inside development; avoid broad search on 49 metros
conservative_xgboost.missing: Native missing handling or identical fold-fitted preprocessing; never replace missing outcomes

validation.atlanta: CBSA12060 is reserved for final assessment after model and tuning rules are frozen; labels physically provided but never use for fitting or selection
validation.development: 5 deterministic whole-MSA folds; use nested tuning or a small predeclared grid, compare identical outer held-out MSAs
validation.processing: All data-dependent preprocessing fitted on the training fold only
metrics: Poisson deviance with strictly positive expected counts
validation.weighting: One MSA one evaluation unit; no forced fit to frame total; no pseudo-replication of company-MSA rows

inference_scope: Covered 98-firm sampled cohort in fixed50 frame; no full500 extrapolation, causal driver claim, all-office claim, year-end occupancy census or as-of2025 forecast
known_missing: Two CT employment-growth cells, one Sacramento management-intensity cell, and one legal relative-wage cell; retained as nulls
design_weights: Retained for coverage/sensitivity; exclusions prevent automatically unbiased full500 estimates
